bugs.description: Splitting the shipment key without limiting from the right truncates account identifiers that contain hyphens and misassigns the sequence component.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A valid shipment key contains a hyphenated account component, such as us-acme-retail-0042.
bugs.observableImpact: The shipment is routed under account acme with sequence retail instead of account acme-retail with sequence 0042.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base parser that took the first segment as region, the final segment as sequence, and joined the intervening segments as account. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.
